facts.text: Lilo, put the peanut butter sandwich down. Your fish is not hungry today. Okay, feed him anyway, but we are late.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Nani's words. Pudge's sandwich is a weekly ritual that Lilo keeps with care, and Nani never says it is not needed. The Nani lines on the page I opened (the koala line, the vampire manager) do not match.
facts.fix: Lilo, feed Pudge his sandwich, then get your hula things. We are late again, and I mean it.

facts.text: Nani's drink between shifts at the luau.
facts.why: The plot says Nani works at the luau until Stitch attacks Pleakley there and she is fired, so a luau worker's drink fits.
